summary: Immuron Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an Appendix 3H notifying ASX of the cessation of 1,430,000 unquoted options (IMCAI) due to expiry without exercise or conversion on June 18, 2026. No consideration was paid for the cessation. The filing is a routine post-cessation notification of expiring options, not a special situation event. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved. The company's quoted ordinary shares remain unchanged at 326,653,609. This is a standard administrative filing with no strategic or transactional significance.
